headline: EU AI Office opens an EDIH catalogue pilot for deployment-ready European AI providers
summary: On 17 November 2026, the European Commission AI Office opened a call inviting European AI providers with mature, SME-deployable solutions to present them to the European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs). The first edition is limited to up to 100 providers; the Commission plans to list selected solutions in an “EDIH Ready” catalogue on the AI-on-Demand Platform so EDIHs can connect them with small and medium-sized enterprises. The source establishes the call and its intended design, not provider selection, SME deployment, adoption or economic impact.
